meta.name: Varam
meta.description: A poor slum dweller's life takes a massive, unexpected turn when he receives a mysterious boon (varam) that alters his fate, fortune, and future.

videos.title: Fortune
videos.overview: Trapped by poverty and humiliated at every turn, Raju's birthday turns hellish when he encounters one misfortune after another. Then he gets a phone alert that changes his destiny.

videos.title: Resound
videos.overview: Raju convinces Nani that his news alerts can predict the future. Desperate to repay Tripathy, they chase a fortune, only to discover that knowing what will happen is not enough.

videos.title: Belief
videos.overview: Satya and Babai don't believe Raju, which costs them dearly. Finally convinced, the gang takes another big gamble and invests in the stock market.

videos.title: Vara
videos.overview: With the Cricket World Cup underway, Raju turns future match results into instant riches. As his bets grow bolder, his dream life begins to cost him his family and his freedom.

videos.title: Criminal
videos.overview: After escaping arrest for match-fixing, Raju suspects that there is a traitor within his circle. When Tripathy sets another trap, Raju turns the game upside down.

videos.title: Curse
videos.overview: Raju outsmarts Tripathy's raids and manipulates the betting market to build an empire. But the price of wealth and power proves too expensive for him.
